parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: This is the cabinet door made of MDF with a wood veneer finish, typically rectangular and attached to the frame with hinges.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the main access point to the cabinet interior, allowing users to open and close the storage space.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about its hinges to open and close.

parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is the cabinet frame made of plywood, forming the structural body that supports the door, shelves, and base.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural integrity and defines the overall shape and strength of the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Cabinet Base
parts.Basic_description: This is the cabinet base made of plywood, located at the bottom of the cabinet structure.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the weight of the cabinet and ensures stability on the floor.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move during normal operation.

parts.name: Shelf 1
parts.Basic_description: This is the first internal shelf made of particle board, rectangular in shape and fitted inside the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a surface for storing items within the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It is typically fixed or adjustable vertically but does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Shelf 2
parts.Basic_description: This is the second internal shelf made of particle board, similar to the first shelf.
parts.Functional_description: It provides additional storage space for organizing items inside the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed or adjustable vertically but does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Shelf 3
parts.Basic_description: This is the third internal shelf made of particle board, located near the top of the cabinet interior.
parts.Functional_description: It provides an upper-level surface for storing smaller or lighter items.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed or adjustable vertically but does not move during normal use.
